correctness.rationale: Character classification is exhaustive because every real nonprincipal character factors uniquely through U_N/U_N^2, a finite elementary abelian 2-group, and each nonzero dual functional appears once. The coefficient formula reduces the root location to an exact rational inequality. Even and B1=0 branches are explicitly handled. Finite conclusions only are asserted.

value.rationale: The first exceptional modulus for degree six is the natural finite threshold of a classical published unimodularity conjecture. The sharp near-failure boundary at 67 measures how close the conjecture remained to failure and identifies the unique extremizing character below the first counterexample. This extends the published 163 example with a complete finite lower-range theorem, not merely a reformulation of the example or a randomly chosen small parameter.
